objective: Make the already-working Tampermonkey Prediction chat transport safely support multiple simultaneous ChatGPT chats while preserving the currently active legacy session during a rolling upgrade.

non_goals: Reintroduce the obsolete Chrome extension transport
Modify the existing command_receiver.py on port 8766
Enable live trading, paid actions, wallet actions or OpenAI API use

acceptance_criteria: Legacy Tampermonkey clients without chat_id continue to receive only unrouted work until v3 fallback registration
Routed work is isolated by chat_id
Duplicate tabs use per-consumer delivery leases
Cross-chat or mismatched-consumer ACK is rejected
Task-to-chat routing is persisted before forwarding a command to the existing 8766 receiver
Installer creates backups and contains no terminal-closing shell behavior
